text.what: Better known for sauvignon blanc, and still making red and rosé from pinot noir on the same Kimmeridgian slopes — lighter than Burgundy, good cold.
text.story: The Loire's upper reaches answered to the dukes of Burgundy, which is the usual explanation for pinot noir being here at all.

kin.as: Grown light, and often drunk chilled.
The duchy this ground once answered to.
